name: Calculator
description: This project develops a smartphone app for a simple calculator. In its initial version, it allows the user to do basic calculations. More complex calculations will be considered in subsequent versions that are added iteratively.
rawDescription: This project develops a smartphone app for a simple calculator. In its initial version, it allows the user to do basic calculations. More complex calculations will be considered in subsequent versions that are added iteratively.
highLevelGoals: The App User wants to accurately and efficiently perform fundamental mathematical calculations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division using the app.
lowLevelGoals: The App User wants to input a digit for the first number into the calculator display.
The App User wants to input a decimal point to create a non-integer number for an operand.
The App User wants to select the addition operator to specify an addition calculation.
The App User wants to select the subtraction operator to specify a subtraction calculation.
The App User wants to select the multiplication operator to specify a multiplication calculation.
The App User wants to select the division operator to specify a division calculation.
The App User wants to input a digit for the second number into the calculator display after an operator has been selected.
The App User wants to trigger the calculation to display the result of the entered expression.
The App User wants to clear the last entered digit or the current operand being typed.
The App User wants to clear all operands, operators, and the displayed result to start a new calculation.

There are no contradictions, out-of-context goals, or major omissions relative to the description of a "simple calculator" for "basic calculations." The granularity is appropriate for user actions.
